speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your pediatric skin lesions, please describe how they started, what they look like, and if they are itchy, painful, or bleeding.

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum. The presence of multiple painless, non-itchy papules on an abdomen, combined with a daycare exposure and a sibling with recent chickenpox, is classic for this viral skin infection. No further testing is required at this time.
